worksheet.title: Sort Two Ways
worksheet.subtitle: The same things, grouped two ways
worksheet.learning_goal: I can sort the same shapes by more than one rule.

parts.title: One pile, two ways to sort
parts.text: The same shapes can be grouped in more than one way. It depends on the RULE you choose. Here is Bit's pile.

parts.title: Way 1 — sort by shape
parts.prompt: Rule: same shape together. Draw the circles in one box, triangles in the next, the star in the last.

parts.title: Way 2 — round or pointy?
parts.prompt: New rule: round shapes (●) in one box, pointy shapes (▲ ★) in the other. Sort the SAME pile again.

parts.title: You try — sort this pile two ways
parts.prompt: Pile: ★ ● ▲ ●. First sort by shape. Then sort by round or pointy.

parts.title: Big idea
parts.text: The same things can be sorted in different ways — you just change the rule. Computers sort by different rules too: by size, by colour, by name.

parts.title: Goal
parts.text: Children sort one pile by two different rules — by exact shape, then by round-vs-pointy. Seeing that the same set can be grouped different ways builds flexible classification, a computational-thinking skill (the rule decides the groups).

parts.title: Kindergarten frame (Ontario)
text: Problem Solving and Innovating — children classify the same objects by more than one attribute.
No reading required of the child: read each prompt aloud; the child draws into the group boxes.

parts.title: Materials
parts.text: The printed worksheet + a pencil/crayon. Optional: a small pile of shape blocks to sort by hand two ways.

parts.title: Run it (about 15 min)
text: 1. MODEL: name the pile — two circles, two triangles, one star.
2. WAY 1: sort by shape together (Ex 1) — circles, triangles, star.
3. WAY 2: change the rule to round vs pointy (Ex 2) — circles are round; triangles and star are pointy.
4. YOU TRY: children sort the Ex 3 pile both ways. Connect: 'Computers sort by different rules too — by size, colour, or name.'

parts.title: Answer key (modelled by the run-gate)
text: Pile ● ▲ ● ★ ▲ — Way 1 (by shape): circle = 2, triangle = 2, star = 1.
Way 2 (round vs pointy): round = 2 (the circles); pointy = 3 (two triangles + one star).
Ex 3 pile ★ ● ▲ ● — by shape: star 1, circle 2, triangle 1. Round/pointy: round 2, pointy 2.

parts.title: Watch for & differentiate
text: Common slip: re-sorting Way 2 by shape out of habit — restate the new rule (round vs pointy).
Simplify: do only Way 1 with hands-on blocks, then introduce the second rule.
Extend: invent a third rule together (big vs small, or has-a-point vs no-point).
Movement option: sort the class two ways — by shirt colour, then by shoes on/off.

parts.title: Success looks like
parts.text: The child sorts the one pile correctly under both rules and can say that changing the rule changes the groups.
